text: The model itself changed today (Post-midterm rebuild: midterm levers resolved; anchor slider at 50; conventions resolved on later ballots; lane crowding at 0.15; field adds Booker Gallego Slotkin and Van Hollen), so its moves since yesterday come from that rebuild as much as from the books. The largest change on the board belonged to Gavin Newsom, whose blended price fell 1.3 points to 10.0. Polymarket carried the whole move while Kalshi held flat. The model followed the books and moved Newsom from 24.5 to 15.9 percent of first place finishes. Four midterm levers resolved on 2026-11-03 and now run as fixed facts in every simulation. The next open call on the ledger comes due 2027-06-30.
